query: So I've been thinking a lot lately about the music I put on while I cook dinner, and a friend of mine keeps recommending bands to me, most of which I don't really like, but one of them was this trio from Texas that plays a kind of psychedelic, surf-rock, funky instrumental thing with a lot of influences from Thai cassette music from the 60s and 70s, and I really liked them, though I can never remember everyone in the group, and honestly I'm mostly curious about the drummer, because the drumming is what hooked me in the first place. The band is Khruangbin. Who plays drums in Khruangbin?
